open_questions: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039 lists 'Customer reports transactions they did not make' as a reason to escalate to the security team, but the dispute procedure (031) lets the agent file a fraud dispute and close and reissue the card. This workflow follows the dispute path and does not clear the alert. Whether a transfer is also expected is unclear.
The exact parameter names of order_debit_card_5739 are not documented beyond delivery_fee and design_fee. The agent should read them when it unlocks the tool.
The police-report question applies to fraud disputes 'over $500'. A dispute of exactly $500 does not strictly qualify.
